messages:
marta: Starting onboarding for RareBird-3B-v1 from FeatherAI. Customer asked for an air-gapped container with quantized weights.
pranav: License text?
marta: Snippet pasted:
```
FeatherAI Model License v1.0
Section 2: Non-commercial use only
Section 4: Redistribution of weights prohibited without express written consent; derivative binaries treated as \"derivative works\"
Section 7: Attribution required
```
lisa (Legal): Short: NC + redistribution ban. We cannot ship quantized weights to a paying customer without a commercial sublicense. Hosting (managed Private) is OK if weights aren’t handed over.
tyler: Infra: we can deliver Redwood Private (managed appliance/VPC) so customer runs inference without receiving weights.
marta: Customer insists on self-run air-gapped container. Options:
1) Request commercial sublicense from FeatherAI.
2) Offer managed Private as interim.
3) BYOW (customer supplies weights + attestation); we provide runtime only.
pranav: For BYOW we need attestation + checksum verification + contract indemnity.
lisa (Legal): Agreed. Also request FeatherAI provide sample sublicense wording and exact attribution text.
pranav: Draft msg to FeatherAI: "Hi FeatherAI — evaluating RareBird-3B-v1 for on‑prem. Do you offer a commercial redistribution sublicense for quantized/derivative weights? If not, is managed hosting or BYOW acceptable? Contact for licensing? —Pranav, Redwood"
ops-bot: deploy-notify: new-private-offer-template v0.9 pushed to /infra/packaging (link)
tyler: I'll sketch BYOW runtime: local-only weight mount, checksum check, no uploads, bundled AUTHORS/attribution docs.
marta: Filing EVAL ticket for 4-bit quality regression (EVAL-4237). Blocking on written permission for on‑prem bundle. I'll send the license ask and keep Legal CC'd.
